fub.definition:
n. Alt. of Fubs
v. t. To put off by trickery; to cheat.
fub.translation:
n. 小而胖的人
v. 欺骗, 借口延迟

fubar.translation:
n. 信息条；信息面板
a. 无法处置的；无法插手整理的

fubringer's tests.translation: [医] 菲布林格氏试验(检白蛋白)

fubsy.definition: a. Plump; chubby; short and stuffy; as a fubsy sofa.
fubsy.translation: a. 肥胖的, 矮胖的
